messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate + cost spike in eu-west-1 affecting tiered routing. Auto-escalation to on-call (alex). Please acknowledge.

alex (oncall): ack — I'm looking. Seeing 5xx increase and a huge token bill from model fallback to xlarge-us-1.

meera (oncall): onphone for the next 8. Handoff if needed. What's the scope? customer-facing?

alex (oncall): Support reports multiple customers in EU reporting slow responses and occasional failures. Metrics: latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 700ms, fallback rate to higher-cost variants up from 2% -> 48%.

jordan (sre): grabbing routing logs. Looks like regional capacity hit and smart-routing started bubbling traffic to US-hosted variants. Cold KV cache misses also spiked.

sophie (support): Got two enterprise customers complaining about timeouts on inference. They want us to confirm impact and ETA.

alex (oncall): Action plan: 1) Rate-limit some non-critical routes in eu-west, 2) apply temporary tiering policy to prevent cross-region fallback, 3) open customer comms draft. Assigning tasks: jordan - implement routing change; meera - handle comms + handoff; sophie - gather affected customer list.

jordan (sre): running a conservative traffic-shape now. Applying policy to prefer local variants and cap cross-region overflow to 10%. Command:```shell
rictl routing update --region eu-west-1 --policy "overflow:10%" --disable-fallback us-variants
```

alex (oncall): +1. Also enable short circuit for best-effort traffic: route tier=free & tier=trial to cache-only where possible.

jordan (sre): Done. Pushed policy change, console shows policy v2 active. Observability: dropped cross-region egress from 47% -> 12% in ~30s.

meera (oncall): Nice. Noted some 503s persist for high-priority customers with pinned model versions — looks like their dedicated pool hit a bad host. We're restarting one worker host as a follow-up.

deploy-bot: Restart job launched for dedicated-pool-eu-3 by jordan — job id: restart-9812. Logs streaming: "drain -> restart -> healthy"

jordan (sre): After restart, health checks green. p95 latency improving to ~180ms, fallback rate down to 6%.

alex (oncall): Good. Now we need to tighten request quotas for noisy routes to avoid recurrence. Proposal: temporary per-customer RPS cap at 50 for non-enterprise, and token quota throttle for free tier: 10k/min. Thoughts?

meera (oncall): Agreed. That's safer than full feature disable. Sophie, can you map which customers would hit those limits so support can pre-warn?

sophie (support): On it — pulling last 24h usage and will DM a list.

alex (oncall): Implementing quotas now. CLI snippet:```json
{
  "selector": "route:completion AND tier:free",
  "quota": {"tokens_per_minute": 10000, "rps": 10},
  "duration": "1800s",
  "reason": "Incident mitigation eu-west overload"
}
```

jordan (sre): Quotas applied. Console shows enforcement starting. Early signal: error rate continues to fall.

meera (oncall): Drafting customer note: short blurb for affected customers + mitigation steps and ETA. Will post to status.redwood.ai if we see stable for 15m.

alex (oncall): Heads-up: one internal cost alert triggered due to model fallback billing spike. Finance notified. We'll include cost mitigation actions in the postmortem.

jordan (sre): Also found that a recent routing rule had an unintended higher preference score for us variants during short windows; rolling that rule back to last stable. Command:```shell
rictl routing rollback --policy-id rp-0821
```

deploy-bot: Rollback succeeded. Policy rp-0821 reverted to v1.

alex (oncall): Summary so far: - Applied overflow cap to 10% to stop cross-region fallback - Restarted bad host in dedicated pool - Applied temporary quotas for free tiers - Rolled back suspect routing rule - Customer comms in progress

meera (oncall): Monitoring window. If we hold 15m with p95 < 250ms and fallback < 10%, we'll move to stable and post short incident update.

sophie (support): Affected customers list DM'd to meera & alex. Two priority customers need direct outreach (account teams looped).

incident-bot: Update: mitigation actions applied at 1778023600, monitoring.

alex (oncall): ack. Starting handoff to meera in 10 min for remainder of night. Meera, you're primary for follow-ups.

meera (oncall): acknowledged. Will continue monitoring and prepare a short RCA draft if stabilized.

jordan (sre): Leaving a note for postmortem: investigate KV cache eviction policy under burst, adjust pre-warming heuristics for EU, and tighten canary window for new routing rules.

meera (oncall): Also adding runbook update: add a quick rollback button for cross-region fallback toggles in Console. That would've saved us time.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Closing active paging for now if metrics stay good. I'll update the incident channel after the 15m stable window. :white_check_mark:
